notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-Utility PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God Arc-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Arc builds. Chrysura Melo is a support-frame auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "damage profile is serviceable, also has two niches in boosting damage and survivability". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, and it shoots tracking projectiles at enemies - any ability or weapon damage generates weapon energy that can be used when hipfiring at allies to heal them, with rapid healing also applying Amplified as per the Destiny Data Compendium. On Support Frames, the Range stat determines how far your bullets will travel before vanishing, so look for that with the barrel perk. In the magazine perk slot, look for perks that improve Range, mag size or Reload Speed. For Arc builds, there's the opportunity for double damage perks with Jolting Feedback in the first trait perk column applying Arc Jolt after 14 hits (11 when amplified) to tougher enemies who can survive the weapon damage, triggering chain lightning on further hits for both target and AoE damage. In the second column, for straight damage, Circle of Life provides a ×1.25 damage boost for a refreshable 10s after rapidly healing allies, or Frenzy after being in combat for 12s - that's dealing or taking damage - boosts Handling and Reload Speed by +100 and boosts damage by ×1.15 for a refreshable 7.2s. For additional arc splash damage, Rolling Storm generates ×1 stack of Arc Bolt Charge (×2 when Amplified) on a kill, to trigger a lightning bolt at ×10 stacks for both target and AoE damage, or Voltshot applies Arc Jolt to the next target you hit within 8s, after a reload within 5.3s of a kill, for additional damage to the target on further hits plus AoE chain lightning damage on nearby enemies. Or for utility, Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~26 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods. Aegis ranks the Ignoble Deeds origin trait as C-Tier for PvE - inflicting an elemental debuff grants 2 stacks, up to a max of 10. One a kill, a stack is consumed to grant +35 to both Handling and Reload Speed until you run out of stacks. If you're interested, the name derives from Greek roots - Chrysura meaning "golden tail", which is a genus of parasitic cuckoo wasps, while Melo stems from "melos" meaning "song" or "melody" - combined, the name translates to "Parasitic Song". Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.
